_comment: The border-design corpus for track byok_svg_borders_20260927 Phase 4 (gallery + prompt polish).
Each entry is a USER INSTRUCTION, in the shape a person would actually type into the BYOK box.
`scripts/border_design_generator.js` pairs it with the PRODUCT's own system message
(`AiLayout.buildMessages`, capabilities {arrange:false, border:true}) and sends the pair to the
live NOUS leg, so what is under test is the product prompt PLUS this instruction — polishing the
one and not the other would polish a prompt the extension never sends.
`criterion` is the visual gate's per-design line. It is written to be DECIDABLE IN PIXELS: a
reviewer that cannot see it in the frame must answer NOT MET, so a criterion that names a
feeling rather than a drawn thing is a defect in this file.
`id` is stable and is what the collage label and the verdict file key on.

designs.title: Gilded double frame
designs.instruction: Draw a restrained double gold rule frame: TWO concentric rectangular rules, one inside the other, each drawn as ONE CONTINUOUS SOLID line running unbroken around all four edges — no gaps, no dashes, no tick marks, no breaks anywhere on either rule. Stroke the rules and the corner diamonds in a GOLD tone (for example #c9a227 or #d4af37) — NOT black, NOT grey. Place a small solid gold diamond at each of the four corners. Keep the lines thin and the interior empty.
designs.criterion: Two concentric rectangular rules in a gold tone are both drawn as continuous SOLID lines closed around the full rectangle — no gaps or dashes anywhere on either rule — a diamond mark sits at each of the four corners, and no rule crosses the interior.

designs.title: Runic tick band
designs.instruction: Draw a narrow band of repeated angular rune ticks running along the top and bottom edges, with a plain rule on the left and right. Place exactly 6 or more angular rune glyphs evenly spaced along the top edge, and exactly 6 or more along the bottom edge. Each glyph must be clearly separated from its neighbours by at least 4px.
designs.criterion: A repeating sequence of at least six separate angular rune glyphs is visible along the top edge AND along the bottom edge, spaced evenly, with plain vertical rules on the left and right.

designs.title: Thorn vine
designs.instruction: Draw a single continuous sinuous vine path that weaves around all four edges — top, right, bottom, left — without breaking. Add small triangular thorns projecting outward and small oval leaves along at least three of the four edges.
designs.criterion: A single continuous sinuous vine path is traceable along all four edges, with thorns or leaves projecting from it on at least three of the four edges.

designs.title: Dragon scale rail
designs.instruction: Draw a rail of overlapping dragon scales around the border, scutes pointing outward. Draw the EXACT SAME scale pattern on all four edges — top, right, bottom, left — so the texture is consistent. Each scale must visibly overlap its neighbour with the top of one scale tucked under the one beside it.
designs.criterion: Overlapping scale shapes are drawn in rows along the border, each scale visibly tucked under or over its neighbour, and the rows read as the same texture on the left/right as on the top/bottom.

designs.title: Celestial arcs
designs.instruction: Draw a celestial border: ONE thin SOLID arc curve along the top edge and ONE thin SOLID arc curve along the bottom edge — each arc a SINGLE UNBROKEN stroke, no dashes, no gaps, no dotted segments. Then draw at least 5 separate small four-pointed star shapes in the space between the two arcs — each star drawn with solid strokes or filled, clearly visible and separate from the others.
designs.criterion: A thin arc curve drawn as a single unbroken solid stroke (no dashes, no gaps) runs along the top edge and along the bottom edge, and at least four separate four-pointed star shapes are visible in the space between them.

designs.title: Chainmail interlace
designs.instruction: Draw an interlocking chainmail ring border, rings overlapping so the weave is obvious.
designs.criterion: At least eight separate ring shapes are visible around the border, drawn so consecutive rings visibly overlap and interlock rather than sitting apart as dots.

designs.title: Concentric corner arcs
designs.instruction: Draw concentric quarter-circle arcs tucked into each of the four corners, growing outward. Each corner must have at least THREE nested arcs. Then draw straight rules joining the corner groups along each edge. Make all four corners have the same nesting direction.
designs.criterion: Each of the four corners shows at least three nested quarter-circle arcs, the nesting direction is consistent at all four corners, and straight rules connect the corner groups along each edge.

designs.title: Flame crest rails
designs.instruction: Draw BOLD flame tongues along the left and right edges: each flame is a FILLED shape at least 8px wide at its base, clearly tapering to a sharp point, so the tongues stay visible even when the border is drawn small. The flame tongues on BOTH edges point INWARD toward the center. The top and bottom edges carry only one plain solid straight rule each.
designs.criterion: FILLED flame tongues, each at least 8px wide at its base and clearly tapering to a sharp point, are drawn along the left edge AND the right edge; the tongues point inward on both sides; and the top and bottom edges carry only a plain straight rule.

designs.title: Frost shard frame
designs.instruction: Draw sharp angular ice shards around all four edges, each shard made of at least two straight line segments forming a faceted crystal shape. At each of the four corners, draw a visibly DENSER cluster of 5 or more shards radiating outward — this corner cluster must be denser and more complex than the shards along the straight edges.
designs.criterion: Sharp angular shard shapes are drawn along the edges, every shard is visibly faceted by at least two straight segments, and each of the four corners carries a denser multi-arm crystalline cluster than the edge run.

designs.title: Ink brush stroke
designs.instruction: Draw a calligraphic ink brush frame: a wet uneven stroke around the border with visible thick-to-thin variation and a small ink dot near one corner.
designs.criterion: The border is drawn as a stroke whose thickness varies visibly along its length (not a constant-width rule), the stroke reads as continuous around the frame, and at least one small detached ink dot is visible near a corner.

designs.title: Starlit void band
designs.instruction: Draw a dark solid band around the border with scattered small stars inside the band and a thin silver inner rule.
designs.criterion: A dark filled band is drawn around the border, at least ten small star marks are scattered inside that dark band, and a thin lighter rule runs along the band's interior edge.

designs.title: Celtic knotwork rails
designs.instruction: Draw celtic knotwork along the top and bottom rails. Each rail must have interwoven strands where you can clearly see at least TWO crossings where one strand goes over and another goes under — use thicker strokes at the over-point and thinner at the under-point to make the over/under break obvious. The left and right edges carry a simpler plain treatment.
designs.criterion: On the top rail and on the bottom rail an interlaced strand pattern is visible, at least one crossing is drawn with an over/under break rather than a plain intersection, and the left and right edges carry a simpler treatment.
